title: festuca littorea
intro: Festuca littorea, commonly known as littoral fescue, is a species of grass that grows in coastal areas. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca littorea include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with infections and injuries. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
